title: Warden attestation ledger v1
description: OPA data document for scripts/warden_policy. Append-only: a new verdict adds a record and advances `latest`; no record is ever edited or deleted.

generation.description: Monotonically incremented on every mutating write. Read by the Hermes adapter under a shared ledger-lock (paired with the writer's exclusive lock) and sent as expected_generation on every OPA query, not just during an OPA outage -- detects OPA serving a stale snapshot after a failed/ambiguous PUT.

plan_review_ttl_seconds.description: Session-bound plan-review attestations older than this are treated as expired by guardrails.rego (LIA-523). Optional -- Rego's own `default plan_review_ttl_seconds := 7200` applies when absent.

enforced_repos.description: Keyed by repo_id. Absent or enabled=false means the repo is outside code-review enforcement scope (commits allow, unconditionally, before any commit-form check). plan_review_enabled is a second, independent, additive on/off switch for the plan-review gate -- absent means plan-review enforcement is off for this repo, regardless of the code-review `enabled` value. Deliberately NOT additionalProperties:false so new sibling switches can be added without a migration (LIA-523).

records.description: Keyed by attestation id (att-<uuid>). Immutable once written.

latest.description: repo_id -> gate -> subject_key -> attestation id. The only part of the document that changes after a new verdict is appended.

latest_by_backend.description: repo_id -> gate -> subject_key -> backend -> attestation id. Additive, optional -- populated only for multi-backend migrated gates (code-reviewer, ai-eng-warden); `latest` is never touched by these writes. Absent entirely on a ledger that has never issued a backend-scoped attestation.

session_id.description: Opaque Hermes session identifier -- stored raw, not hashed/digested (nothing sensitive to redact, unlike a repo-relative git path).

reviewer_id.description: <role>@<backend>, e.g. code-reviewer@claude-sonnet-5 -- mirrors verdict_store.py's record_script_verdict vocabulary.

backend.description: Present only for multi-backend migrated-gate attestations (indexed under latest_by_backend); absent for legacy single-attestation records indexed under latest.
